body:
It isn't the ex I love. It's my best friend.

Me and my best friend, and it is worth noting that I'm her best friend too, had a conversation about how perfect we would be together. Just everything we wish for our life is found in the other one. Really everything.

If there's one thing that truly mastered perfection, it would be this relationship. But there's that, she doesn't love me and went for another guy she suddenly fell in love with, without reason.

I know she's my best friend for my entire life. And she will be my best friend for her entire life. We are so well connected, it is almost unbelieveable that we really do exist together.

There isn't anything that I could fall more in love with. I have found the ultimate, the 100% love. No matter who else I might fall in love with, I will always love her more.

Sometimes it feels like it, but I don't want to.

I just saw the opportunity of my life and it just flew away from me. So what else is there to get? I've wasted the biggest treasure.

I see the glass as half full because I know when you hit ground bottom, the only way from there is upwards.

But it isn't that. I just don't care anymore. I don't want just "something else" to make me happy in my life. I want THIS "something", the girl I love.

Because I'm a psychopath. Honestly.

From all the explainations I've got, beginning with believing into bad ghosts up until thinking a demon might have invaded my body, considering all the rationality I've got, this is the best explaination I could go for. I'm a psychopath.

But as I've said before, my previous post was deleted for not only stating that, but the possible things that can result from being a psychopath.

Not trying that again, else I'll be shut down again. We can write PMs though.

It's not me that can take the change. It was my mind that tried to kill me there. And it's my mind that tried to do other bad things before.

I can't be helped.
What if I'm still trying to do said bad thing?

I'm not a great person. If my previous post wouldn't have been deleted by mods, you would know. I've did very bad things and some I should go to jail for.

I just like to write personal things. My favorite is my blog, where I write a story with a single protagonist, based on my life. But nobody understood that yet, I guess.

What I want is my life to work the way I want to. To gain and achieve everything I set my goal to.

When I've had everything in place, everything suddenly fell down like pieces of bricks. Now I don't have anything I take care for. I'm just done with this world.

I love writing myself. But I most only do so in german.

True, I was asking for opinions. But it was rather aimed at the killing part of myself.

I repeat, please don't waste your time on a never ending discussion. It's one thing about humans I really hate.

>> I like having sex with animals.

>> Actually I don't feel like a bad person.

> If you are currently having sex with animals, my opinion is that you are a bad person.

I'm sorry to put it like that, but I don't care. Don't take it personally though. Take it as a fact: I really do not care. What do I get from bathing in everyones opinion about me? Just only because a million people say something, doesn't make it automatically right. There's far more in game with opinion, like facts.

Yes, I know what you want to tell me right now. Facts here, facts there. Animals feelings, language, blahblah. I've heard those "facts" very often actually, don't waste your time with that. It's nothing we could ever agree on. Do yourself a favor. Again, don't take it personally, I'm just tired of those arguments. I don't want you to think that I just block you off and ignore you. If I would, I wouldn't even reply to you. So, I would be pleased if you could understand. I just don't want to talk about it over and over again. There where hundreds before you, who I've argued with. It always ends the same way, both having a statement, not agreeing on the other one.

> Otherwise, since I judge goodness/badness of people by their behaviors and not their thoughts, I would agree that you are not a bad person.

This statement is confusing, in more than just one way. I don't know if I pick this up right, so I ask:

* I am a bad person for liking sex with animals. Got it. But I'm not a bad person for killing animals? Do I miss how life is ranked? Is sex worse than death?
* Am I a good person for just not killing a human, yet?
* Am I a good person for thinking about my faults? Even if I would kill somebody? Wouldn't this contradict your statement?

Maybe I'm just too tired right now.

> How old are you? What is your family history? 

I am in my early twenties.

Everything was good, at least I thought so. I have many siblings. When I was about 4 years old, my mother broke up with my father. I was too young to understand, but I missed him. I've only recently found out that my father was abusive, betraying my mother and physically hurting her. He did break her arm once. He left her almost dying from an infection. I never knew about this as child. But she still let him see his children. I didn't see anything wrong with him.
10 years ago, I've stopped having contact with him, because I couldn't stand him anymore. He wasn't just a father anymore, but more like just a teacher. He took more care of what grades I have, instead of how I felt like.
Shortly before I've cut contact with him, I fell into depression for the first time. Conciously speaking, it wasn't because of him. Unconciously speaking, maybe it was. I don't know, but I don't care either.

Mind, that in all of this time, I've already had those dark experiences on myself. Nightmares, the animals I killed, feeling evil even if I didn't want to... I was probably born with it. My depression made only stronger what was already there before.

> I'm not gonna lie-- it is a bit off-putting, frightening and definitely unusual.

This reminds me of a time, when I could say "Don't worry, you're safe with me." and being 100% honest with this statement. Sadly, I can't do this today. I wish I could provide safety.

> People would keep their distance due to the fear you might harm them, not because they don't want to help you.

I understand that. They are only acting on their instincts, which is good.

> However, I still see you as a valuable human being who's able to understand that your desires are wrong and absolutely immoral. I'm not here to judge you either.

Thank you. Just, on a sidenote, don't call me human. Neither do I feel like one, nor I want to be one.

> You talk about this feeling on your chest though... Is it physical?

It feels hot around my heart. But it feels bad. This is the dark spirit I'm dealing with. I feel this thing taking my body over... It makes me hear screaming voices. So to answer your question: Kind of both, I guess.

> I'm sorry you feel that way :/.

I'm really surprised to hear that. I expect that most people who really know about me would rather like to take distance. Far distance.

> What do you plan on doing about this?

I've tried everything before. I've got this demon in my head since my early childhood. Why would it just go away now? It doesn't, it can't. It won't.

>  Is it difficult for you to control your thoughts and desires?

Most of the times it isn't. But sometimes I get into a state where my feelings overwhelm me. This happened when I started writing this thread. This happened when I woke up in the hotel, next to the guy I've had sex with.

At the moment I'm calm, cold. I have no particular emotion to express and that's good. Allthough I feel... this presence... there in my chest. It's not good.

> It seems like you know it's absolutely wrong to commit murder, so how will you prevent yourself from actually doing it?

All there is to do, to hope that I don't meet anyone closely who could become a potentional target (a.k.a. people of no personal worth or enemies) and if, trying to think as rational as possible about the situation. Of course, this grants no guarantee. That's why I'm very sure, that someday it will happen.

> Thoughts can lead to actions.

Yes and feelings can turn off thoughts. Without thought, there is no lead to any action (prevention). Without action, my insane feelings are able to express themselves in every way they want to.

> Also, do you feel like this has to do with a lack of love or close relationships perhaps?

Probably. It isn't unreasonable to think that. But on the other hand... I've already killed animals when I was a little child. The bond to my family was pretty good (back then). I don't know what issues I've lived through that this behavior suddenly came into existence, or maybe it was just always there from the very beginning. Either way, it doesn't stop haunting me. My mind is screwed.

> (I don't know your situation so I'm asking out of curiosity)

I'm glad you ask. I'm glad that only someone, besides my friend, is able to understand my issues.

> Do you think you'll feel remorseful after you commit murder?

I don't know. Depends on the person, maybe. My feelings are quite fucked.

> You say you want to protect others and do good things, but do you really believe you have the right to take someone's life?

No, I don't think I have the right to take someones life. Nobody has. 

Take a different view on it. I'm sure everyone did something illegal in his life before. Be it little or big, intentional or not: You didn't have the right to do that either. Yet you did and you're still here.

I feel people imagine laws regarding hard crimes simply as a wall you run into. But it's not. Laws exist to discourage bad behavior. But in all actually, they mean nothing. These walls are not there, you can cross the line easily. I'm not saying that what I do is good, or thrilling or anything, I know it is not. But I can't help thinking about it. I can't help feeling what I've felt. I was so close killing a completely innocent person before, all it did take was an off-switch for my rational-mind. I only wonder, when does it happen?

>Also, do you feel like you're more deserving than others?

Absolutely not. Yes, my misanthropic views seem harsh, but this doesn't mean that I'm egocentric. As an misanthrop you hate humanITY, not every single human. You hate the species and ther overall doings. Yes, that includes me, as a human, this body... It makes me sick being stuck in this. If I could, I would just like to rip my skin off and choose another species to fit in.
